/book: What types of bungalow can I book?
The resort website lists one- and two-bedroom beachfront and lagoon-view accommodation. Select your dates and guest numbers to check current availability.
The resort is on Efate Island in Shefa Province, Vanuatu. Contact the team for directions from Port Vila or the airport.
What time are check-in and check-out?
The website lists check-in at 2:00 PM and check-out at 10:00 AM. Ask the team about requests outside those times.
How can I arrange a group stay?
Contact the resort with your dates, guest numbers, and preferred room types so the team can confirm availability.
/menu: The restaurant is at E'Nauwi Beach Resort on Efate Island, Vanuatu, overlooking the lagoon.
Where can I see current dishes and prices?
Browse the current restaurant menu on this page. Contact the resort if you need help confirming availability.
Can I ask about dietary requirements?
Contact the resort before your visit to discuss your dietary requirements and what the kitchen can offer.
Can I enquire about group dining?
Contact the team with your preferred date, group size, and meal requirements to ask about options.
/services: How do I enquire about a conference?
Send your dates, expected guest numbers, and meeting requirements to the resort so the team can confirm current facilities and availability.
Can I request a tailored quote?
Yes. Contact the resort with your requirements and ask for a quote based on the services currently available.
The resort offers bungalow accommodation. The team can confirm room availability for your event dates.
What should I confirm before reserving?
Confirm room capacity, equipment, catering, accessibility requirements, opening status, and the final quote with the resort.
/activities: How do I enquire about an activity?
Choose an activity on this page and contact the resort to confirm availability and make arrangements.
Do activities depend on the weather?
Outdoor and water activities may depend on conditions. Ask the resort for current advice before making plans.
Suitability varies by activity. Tell the team the children's ages and ask about supervision and safety requirements.
Are activity prices included in accommodation?
Check with the resort which activities are included and which have additional charges before booking.
